dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible. The most prominent 3-5 rings in the mid-body display irregular, jagged perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity light perimeters to dark, low-intensity centers. The geometry is characterized by non-uniform thickness in the outer ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is present along the dorsal ridge and posterior transition area. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, localized concentrations of light pixels against the darker background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the mid-lateral region form an irregular quadrilateral. Connecting these with the centroids of the two highest-density blobs on the upper dorsal edge creates a complex, non-linear polygonal network with acute angles at the posterior-most points.
